agent_explanation: Body 1 (high speed ~27.7 m/s) collides with initially stationary body 0 around steps 26-27. Collision impulses give body 0 ~30.6 m/s horizontal velocity. With large dt=0.0171 even with 17-18 substeps, semi-implicit Euler integration moves body 0 ~0.52m per step, so it reaches and then exceeds the right arena wall (x=20) in a few steps. Smaller dt avoids accumulating enough error to breach the 0.15 tolerance. Counterfactual with only dt reduced confirms numerical integration / substep resolution as cause.
